roleTitle: Senior Java Backend Developer and Software Architect
profileParagraphs: Joel is a senior Java backend developer and software architect with a master's degree in computer science from KTH and more than 14 years of experience in software development. He has deep experience with Java, Spring Boot, SQL, PostgreSQL, API design, microservices and integration-heavy distributed systems.

He has delivered business-critical backend services in banking and payments, e-health, education, culture and startup environments. His work includes system design, data modeling, REST APIs, distributed services, asynchronous integrations, CI/CD, logging, quality practices and systems with high requirements for traceability, integrity, uptime, performance and test coverage.

Joel is an analytical and pragmatic problem solver with strong pedagogical skills. He quickly understands complex flows, internal organizations and technical stacks, and contributes with architecture, implementation, code review, debugging, operational troubleshooting and knowledge sharing across teams.
